judge.rationale: The candidate invents its own message and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of using the exact names required by the ticket (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it explicitly violates the ticket's requirement and acceptance criteria by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is missing instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame. Validation also fails the acceptance criteria by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200`, and documentation updates in `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` were skipped (along with leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree).
